listing.title: Polaris Fuel
listing.offerText: Polaris Fuel is a guild and faction-agnostic mining union for Star Atlas that empowers miners through collective organization, decentralized governance, and shared infrastructure. We operate independently across all three factions (ONI, MUD, USTUR) while providing community-driven tools, coordination platforms, and collective bargaining power to ensure miners, from solo operators to major guilds, have a voice in the metaverse economy. Est. March 2022 · Team: DRUMCARL05, Omaristo, Birr4s.
